catalyst.event: Year-end target for 300 MW delivered in North Dakota. Check the service status of the remaining 25 MW.

gaps.input: How many shares will new financing create?
gaps.source: Reconcile Series G issuance and conversion terms in 8-Ks to the next 10-Q share count.

gaps.input: How much rent will reach common shareholders?
gaps.source: Trace project debt, remaining build costs and preferred distributions in the next financing exhibits and 10-Q.

invalidation.reason: A daily close below the November 25 low breaks the setup. An announced delivery delay or funding gap would trigger an earlier review.

objective.condition: A daily close above $12.50 with the delivery timetable and funding plan intact.
objective.method: One November 25 trading range ($1.72) above that day’s high ($12.50), rounded to $14.20.

report.peer_read: Applied Digital trades at 4.26× trailing sales. Its tenants pay rent, and preferred investors have priority over common shareholders. A GPU operator’s sales multiple has limited use here.

signals.text: The first 25 MW at Polaris Forge 2 reached ready-for-service status. Commissioning covers another stage before delivery.
Series G financing capacity rose to $2.5B. Future conversions can dilute common shares.
At August 31, $2.91B of the group’s $2.95B cash sat inside TopCo2, where project claims have priority.

sources.title: November 25 regular-session price and range; observed November 26

report.thesis: Another 25 MW would close the gap to the year-end delivery target. The equity case depends on how much rent reaches common shareholders after construction and financing costs.

recording_basis: First observed in this immutable archive; not an asserted original publication timestamp.
